subtests.name: Inserting a non-selected option does not replace selectedcontent children.
Inserting many non-selected options does not repeatedly replace selectedcontent children.
Inserting an option that causes another option to be selected updates selectedcontent.
Inserting multiple options together updates selectedcontent once.
Inserting selectedcontent followed by an option updates selectedcontent once.
Inserting an option followed by selectedcontent updates selectedcontent once.
Inserting selectedcontent followed by an option that changes selectedness updates every selectedcontent once.
Inserting a select that already contains options updates its selectedcontent once.
